title: Pip and the One Good Perch
checkpoint: Year 1 Spring 1, week 4 — School readiness — Phase 5: new ways to say and spell ch, ow, ie
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 5 complete (School readiness) — Phonics Screening Check review week, practising across the whole code.

pages.text: Pip spots one good perch on the window box.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow looking at a single small wooden perch fixed to the side of a window box.
Ned the duckling waddling over, looking up at the same perch.
Olive the owl flying down towards the same perch.
Moss the hedgehog stretching up on his back legs, looking at the same perch.

pages.text: They can not all fit on one perch.
pages.illustration: Pip, Ned, Olive and Moss all crowded around the single small perch, unable to fit.

pages.text: Pip has a plan: take turns.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow standing in front of the others, explaining with a raised wing.

pages.text: Pip sits first, then it is Ned.
pages.illustration: Pip the sparrow sitting on the perch while Ned the duckling waits just below.

pages.text: Then Olive gets a turn on the perch.
pages.illustration: Olive the owl now sitting on the perch, looking pleased.

pages.text: Then Moss gets the last turn.
pages.illustration: Moss the hedgehog balanced carefully on the perch, the others watching from below.

pages.text: Pip grins. Turns are a good plan.
pages.illustration: Pip, Ned, Olive and Moss standing together by the window box, all smiling.
